claim: One AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory can be shared with 25 accounts (Standard Edition), 500 accounts (Enterprise Edition) or 125 accounts (Hybrid Edition) by default. Before 2025-08-15 the limits were 5 (Standard) and 125 (Enterprise).
question: With how many AWS accounts can one AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory be shared, per edition?

qualifiers.condition: the quota pages do not say whether it can be raised; adjustable=false is unverified

evidence.quote: | Shared domains per Standard Microsoft AD \*\*\* | 25 |
| Shared domains per Enterprise Microsoft AD \*\*\* | 500 |
| Shared domains per Hybrid Microsoft AD \*\*\* | 125 |

AWS has increased the account sharing limits for AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory sharing, allowing customers to share their directories with significantly more AWS accounts. The Standard Edition limit has increased from 5 to 25 accounts, while the Enterprise Edition limit has expanded from 125 to 500 accounts.

changed.was: The Standard Edition limit has increased from 5 to 25 accounts

note: d023. The footnote says shared domains means the number of accounts a directory can be shared to.
